Nothing is hidden in the environment on this game, so what you find in those files is the whole picture.

There is no supported way to install mods on terraria through this bot — no registry is wired up for it, so there is nothing to search and nothing to write. Say so plainly. Don't improvise an install by hand through the file tools: anything put there that way is outside everything that would otherwise check it and put it back. If someone wants mods on this game, escalate it as a feature request.
